description: Main window: dragging the window by its top bar (macOS overlay title bar; on Windows our top bar is the whole title bar, with its own minimise / maximise / close buttons),local SQLite store, OS notifications, the unread badge, external links in the system browser, the text size (webview zoom), saving a download into the Downloads folder under a free name (or where the user picked in the save dialog), the drive (M161): a large download written chunk by chunk into a file there (removed when it fails), and the files and folders picked in the open dialog read in parts for an upload (the dialog adds them to the scope; persisted-scope keeps them after a restart so the upload resumes), showing a saved download in Finder / Explorer and opening one saved in Downloads in its app (never a program or script: those are denied here and in platform/download.ts), the credential-store commands, the `chikuwachat://` link that launched the app (Google sign-in), and in-app updates (check, download and install, then relaunch), and the window full screen for an album's slideshow (AL2).
